Kwame, the official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to you was November 3, 2025. I replied in the thread in #coastal-team.

Moss's Coastal digest of November 2, 2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Bettina's recap note of December 8, 2025 also gives November 3 as the official handoff. The same note says Bettina ran the account day to day until November 21 and you fully took over on November 22, 2025.

I used a plain date style in the channel because your day.month.year preference applies only to our DMs. I offered to DM you the date as 03.11.2025 for the CRM import, but I haven't sent it yet.
